decisions.reason: The evening day-patient program is reimbursed psychiatric care that builds on existing clinical teams and has its own page, so keeping it costs little while demand from working patients is still being learned.
The carpentry workshop uses existing sheltered-workshop infrastructure and serves the firm's mission of employment for people with disabilities, so holding the option open is cheap.
Outpatient sociotherapy is close to the core business and reimbursed by health insurers, so despite low visibility the cost of waiting is low and abandoning it would be premature.
Senior living counseling is prominently featured, needs minimal resources, and channels clients into the firm's eldercare services, which signals favorable resolution of its uncertainty.

The retail shop carries fixed running costs and remains low-visibility, but it supports workshop sales and is still too new to show that its value cannot be realized, so the option stays open for another year.
Meal delivery for seniors was launched in 2024 and leverages existing kitchens and eldercare clients, so its uncertainty is unresolved and keeping it is inexpensive.
